_comment: Single source of truth for the plan and dashboard. Edit THIS file, then regenerate the dashboard with `python src/build_dashboard.py`. Every task carries owner (me|agent), priority (P0|P1|P2), and status (todo|in-progress|blocked|done).

phases.title: Phase 0 — Foundation
phases.goal: Stand the project up and make it run locally.
phases.deliverable: Repo scaffolded, dev server runs, one page renders.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Core loop
phases.goal: The one thing the product does, end to end.
phases.deliverable: A user can complete the core flow and get output.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Ship
phases.deliverable: Live on a real URL, funnel measured.

tasks.title: Set the production API key / secrets
tasks.note: Agents can't provision credentials — everything downstream waits on this.

tasks.title: Register the domain
tasks.note: Needed before the deploy step can point DNS.

tasks.title: Approve the launch post before it goes out
tasks.note: Agent drafts it; you press send under your own name.

tasks.title: Build the shared engine + one thin view
tasks.note: Stable /api contract; provider behind a switch.

tasks.title: Draft the first SEO landing page
